intro: Morndo comes set up for software work. Connect your code and your agents once and the lanes can work. You can change everything later.

skills.name: /fix-with-proof
skills.summary: Fix a bug: first a test that fails, then the fix.

skills.name: /build-feature
skills.summary: Build from a short spec, in small reviewed steps.

skills.name: /review
skills.summary: A fresh reviewer reads a change and lists what is wrong.

skills.name: /qa-by-hand
skills.summary: Click through a change in a real browser, with screenshots.

skills.name: /release
skills.summary: Roll out in steps, watch it, and roll back if it goes wrong.

skills.name: /red-main
skills.summary: Find why main is red and fix it, or say what stops it.

skills.name: /upgrade
skills.summary: Update dependencies one at a time, with tests after each.

skills.name: /what-broke
skills.summary: Read production errors and say what broke and since when.

skills.name: /decision-brief
skills.summary: Put an open question into your decision format.

connections.name: Cursor
connections.purpose: Agent, does QA in the browser

guardrails.name: Production
guardrails.detail: Ask me before anything is released

guardrails.name: Database
guardrails.detail: Backup first, and ask me before a change

guardrails.name: Merging
guardrails.detail: Tests and one fresh review before any merge

guardrails.name: Tries
guardrails.detail: 3 tries at a fix, then stop and ask

guardrails.name: Keys
